title: FRP Grating Supplier in Australia: Complete Buying Guide 2026
author: ZeAll Team
excerpt: Sourcing FRP/GRP grating from China to Australia? Complete guide on pricing, shipping, compliance (AS/NZS), lead times and why ZeAllgrate is the preferred Australian supplier.
content:
1. Why Buy FRP Grating from China for Australia?

Australia has strict corrosion requirements in mining, wastewater, marine infrastructure and chemical plants. Domestic supply is expensive and limited. Importing FRP (GRP) grating from China saves 40-60% on material cost with identical quality. ZeAllgrate has supplied FRP grating to Australian mining companies, water utilities and engineering contractors for over 8 years.

2. Australian Standards & Compliance

FRP grating supplied to Australia must comply with AS/NZS 3610 (method of test for floorings) and AS 1657 (fixed platforms, walkways, stairs and ladders). Our molded grating meets non-slip class R10/R11, and pultruded grating exceeds AS 1657 load requirements. All shipments include mill test certificates, resin identification and fire classification reports (ASTM E84 Class B). For mining applications, we offer anti-static and UV-resistant resin systems.

3. Pricing & Shipping to Australia (2026)

Typical CIF Sydney/Melbourne pricing per m2: Molded 38mm isophthalic: USD 48-62/m2. Pultruded 50mm vinyl ester: USD 68-88/m2. Standard panel size 1220x3660mm. Shipping: LCL 12-18 days, FCL 20-25 days via sea freight from Shanghai. For urgent orders, air freight available for samples. MOQ: 50m2. Custom sizes cut to your drawings.

4. Popular Australian Applications

Mining: access walkways around processing plants, conveyor galleries. Water treatment: clarifier covers, tank grating. Marine: boat ramps, pontoon decking, jetties. Chemical: electrolyte rooms, battery rooms. Food & beverage: brewery grating, dairy plant flooring. Infrastructure: footbridge decking, anti-slip stair treads.
